summary: Honor nonnegative community-sync page limits, write each fetched page promptly, and report saved row totals even when a later page fails or the finite cap is reached.
reason: The community resource path silently rewrote limits to 100; negative values could bypass the cap, long runs accumulated raw records, and late errors lost earlier pages. A cap warning must appear before completion, and the final summary must count rows already saved even when their resource fails.
validated_outcome: Local tests verify page 101 is persisted, zero means unlimited, negative limits fail before requests, member pagination uses its tab parameter, earlier pages survive a late error, and a cap warning precedes completion.
